answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46838 Country: Pakistan Title: Sunnat moakida and Faraz Qaza Question: I have many thousands of prayers remaining. Can I say these prayers instead of saying the sunnah muwakkadah daily? What I mean is that will fardh-qaza prayers have priority over sunnah muwakkadah? Answer ID: 46838 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1217/1115/N=9/1434) You should perform the missed fardh salah as well the sunnah muwakkadah. You should not miss the daily sunnah muwakkadah due to the missed salah; otherwise you will have to bear the sin of forsaking sunnah muwakkadah without any valid reason. Yes, you may leave other nafl salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
